context: Sho-young arranges his own room for the first time; proud display to Mei.
purpose: Child showing independence task to mother.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Bright, almost breathless with pride. Quick energetic attack on the opening. Eager for approval, bouncing slightly in the voice. Wants her to see it right now.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.style: Warm delight with genuine surprise underneath. Soft inhale on the opening. Eyes lighting up — not performed, actually moved by his effort. Gentle, admiring tone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: I cleaned up my desk and bookshelf!
lines.style: Proud, still soft underneath — not boasting, just sharing what he did. Slight lift on each item he lists. Quiet confidence. Waiting a beat for her reaction.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: You did all that by yourself. You really tried hard.
lines.style: Tender recognition, no condescension. Slow, thoughtful pace. Lands gently on 「頑張った」 — acknowledging the effort, not just the result. Warm eye contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Simple, genuine pleasure. Bright and quick, but not frantic. The happiness of being seen and appreciated. Small, authentic laugh underneath.
